tools.name: piggyvest_list_wallets
tools.description: List the business's API wallets with the total balance (kobo) and a page of wallets. Good first call to find wallet ids. GET /api/v1/wallet/api/wallet-type.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_wallet
tools.description: Get one wallet: name, status, balance (kobo), interest rates and virtual account id. GET /api/v1/wallet/{wallet_id}.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_wallet_accounts
tools.description: List the bank account numbers that fund a wallet (virtual accounts with bank names). GET /api/v1/wallet/{wallet_id}/accounts.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_wallet_interest
tools.description: List stored interest accruals for a wallet over a date range (defaults to the current calendar month). GET /api/v1/wallet/interests/accrued/{wallet_id}.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_banks
tools.description: List the banks supported for transfers, with each bank's code. Use the code as bankCode in piggyvest_transfer_to_bank. GET /api/v1/transfer/bank-list.

tools.name: piggyvest_name_enquiry
tools.description: Check the account holder name for a bank account before a transfer. Use it to confirm the payee. GET /api/v1/transfer/name-enquiry.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_transaction_status
tools.description: Check the status (success, pending or failed) of a transfer by the reference you sent. Use it after a transfer to confirm the final result. GET /api/v1/transaction/verify.

tools.name: piggyvest_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction by its PiggyVest id: amount, fee, status, wallets and balances after the move. GET /api/v1/transaction/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_transactions
tools.description: List the business's transactions, newest first, with filters for wallet, status, direction, category and dates. GET /api/v1/transaction.

tools.name: piggyvest_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers created through this API, with optional filters by your own id or the PiggyVest customer id. GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: piggyvest_create_wallet
tools.description: Create a new API wallet for a customer. Creation is asynchronous: the reply is only a wallet id, and the wallet is ready after a few minutes. POST /api/v1/wallet/sub-account.

tools.name: piggyvest_create_customer
tools.description: Create a business customer and its default wallet. Sends personal identity data (BVN) to PiggyVest for verification: send only what the customer agreed to share. POST /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: piggyvest_reserve_account
tools.description: Reserve a bank account number for a wallet. A regular account stays active; a disposable account expires after the expiry minutes. POST /api/v1/wallet/reserve-account.

tools.name: piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets
tools.description: MOVES MONEY: transfer kobo from one of this business's wallets to another. Needs confirm=true. The reply is 202 (processing): check the result with piggyvest_get_transaction_status. Do not retry with the same reference; check it first. POST /api/v1/transfer/wallet.

tools.name: piggyvest_transfer_to_bank
tools.description: MOVES MONEY: send kobo from a wallet to an external bank account. Call piggyvest_name_enquiry first. Needs confirm=true. The reply is 202 (processing): check the result with piggyvest_get_transaction_status. Do not retry with the same reference; check it first. POST /api/v1/transfer/bank.

tools.name: piggyvest_schedule_payment
tools.description: SCHEDULES A FUTURE PAYMENT: a one-time or recurring transfer from a wallet to a wallet or bank account. Needs confirm=true. Cancel it later with piggyvest_set_schedule_payment_active. POST /api/v1/transfer/schedule-payment.

tools.name: piggyvest_set_schedule_payment_active
tools.description: Set a scheduled payment active or inactive. is_active=false cancels it (no more runs). is_active=true reactivates it and needs confirm=true. A payment whose end date has passed cannot be reactivated. PATCH /api/v1/transfer/schedule-payment/{schedule_payment_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets, piggyvest_transfer_to_bank · Private data: piggyvest_list_wallets, piggyvest_get_wallet, piggyvest_get_wallet_accounts, piggyvest_get_wallet_interest, piggyvest_list_transactions, piggyvest_create_wallet, piggyvest_create_customer, piggyvest_reserve_account, piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets, piggyvest_transfer_to_bank, piggyvest_schedule_payment · Public sink: piggyvest_create_wallet, piggyvest_create_customer, piggyvest_reserve_account, piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets, piggyvest_transfer_to_bank, piggyvest_schedule_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets, piggyvest_transfer_to_bank · Private data: piggyvest_list_wallets, piggyvest_get_wallet, piggyvest_get_wallet_accounts, piggyvest_get_wallet_interest, piggyvest_list_transactions, piggyvest_create_wallet, piggyvest_create_customer, piggyvest_reserve_account, piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets, piggyvest_transfer_to_bank, piggyvest_schedule_payment · Public sink: piggyvest_create_wallet, piggyvest_create_customer, piggyvest_reserve_account, piggyvest_transfer_between_wallets, piggyvest_transfer_to_bank, piggyvest_schedule_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
